text.p: These are the leading stories in the Mozambican press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- The Mozambican government announced on Thursday that it wants to raise US$174 million for rehabilitation of the northern port of Nacala and the railway which links the port to Malawi. This will be the core of the Nacala Development Corridor, similar to programmes already under way between Maputo and South Africa and between Beira and Zimbabwe.

- Parliament voted yesterday in favour of fixing the land tenure period in Mozambique at 50 years, renewable at the occupant's request. A proposal by the main opposition Renamo party to cut the period to 25 years was defeated.

- Norway, Sweden and Switzerland on Thursday pledged support of US$4.2 million for the Mozambican Planning and Finance Ministry's institutional capacity-building plans. The donation is being split equally between the three European countries and covers the period 1997-99.
